scope: Node VM execution of actual downloaded-file prototype helpers with controlled timers and minimal DOM. No Electron DownloadItem, network, PDF/Office native renderer, ACP, filesystem durability, Windows or CSS rendering is tested.

tests.name: IDE import rejects Windows traversal, reserved devices and invalid names
IDE import chooses noncolliding Windows case-insensitive path and parent
IDE import avoids treating an existing directory as a new file
IDE import checks project before opening, changing files or switching panels
IDE import rejects missing identity, invalid version and binary content
IDE import size ceiling counts UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 length
Repeat import preserves dirty and saved modifications without duplicating
New downloaded revision creates independent IDE copy without touching old edits
Same identity/revision with changed source is rejected even after copy deletion
HTML imported to IDE stays exact text; no markup executor is invoked
Explorer Git decorations distinguish known status from unknown and explicit clean
Explorer Git conflicts take precedence; index markers require real staged evidence
Actual explorer rename and Undo preserve import identity and dirty copies
Download names strip traversal and normalize Windows reserved filenames
Download collision naming is Windows case-insensitive and keeps extension
Source references redact credentials, query tokens and fragments
Repeated samples have stable unique identities and do not mutate older records
Pause stops progress; resume completes the same record once
A retained timer cannot progress after pause-resume generation changes
Cancel and retry reset progress without adding another record
Demonstration failure exposes failed state then retry completes exactly once
Project switch does not reroute background completion or persistence
Project rename keeps stable scope and running transfer identity without duplication
Project rename preserves editor draft, expected revision and IDE import identity
Empty download manager project rename updates open owner without fabricating records
Legacy download list is retained without making up files or crashing
Reloaded in-progress records become paused with no spontaneous timer
Immutable original survives revisions; stale revisions and invalid JSON are rejected
Binary, partial and large byte-counted content cannot become editable text
Revision writes reject non-text values, NUL and excess UTF-8 bytes
HTML preview escapes source; scripts and handler markup remain inert text
Preview bounds large content instead of loading claimed two-gigabyte body
Stale dialog save cannot modify a different newly opened file
Stale close callback cannot close a newer download dialog
Changed project invalidates old editor callbacks without losing existing draft
Persistence failure preserves new revision in memory and displays durable-save warning
Thrown storage failure keeps transfer running with a truthful warning on reopen
Closing a dirty editor asks locally and preserves its draft when leaving
Destroy invalidates already captured timer callbacks
IDE handoff sends saved source with original revision zero and no fake success
Agent handoff sends bounded reference, not complete content or secret URL
Unsaved drafts cannot silently pass an older saved copy to IDE or agent
Late handoff completion does not overwrite a different file dialog
Download reference integrates with real IDE helper for original and edited revisions
